findings.reader: A disciplined, well-bounded news article: it answers the invitation question first, defines terms at first use, keeps the cancelled-message example mechanically faithful to the draft's safe-stopping language, and preserves the crucial distinction between published intent and implemented behavior. Explain-back and a novel transfer scenario both resolve correctly from the article alone. No failure families present.
findings.facts: All ten claims are supported verbatim or near-verbatim by the supplied Microsoft announcement and draft code texts, including the September 14 date, six-week window, MAI-only scope, not-training-today status, safe-stopping language, and the acknowledged gap between written objectives and behavior. Dates, limits and attribution are preserved throughout; no factual defects found.
